notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Forests.
description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Rofellos.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Rofellos.
Repeat.
